SELECT 
  id as session_id,
  telegram_user_id,
  language,
  status,
  first_name as session_first_name,
  started_at
FROM candidate_sessions
WHERE telegram_user_id = $1
LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO candidate_sessions (
  telegram_user_id,
  first_name,
  status,
  started_at,
  language
) VALUES ($1, $2, 'in_progress', NOW(), 'ru')
ON CONFLICT (telegram_user_id) 
DO UPDATE SET 
  status = CASE 
    WHEN candidate_sessions.status = 'completed' THEN 'in_progress'
    ELSE candidate_sessions.status 
  END,
  first_name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.first_name, candidate_sessions.first_name)
RETURNING id as session_id, telegram_user_id, status, language, first_name as session_first_name

SELECT 
  id,
  position_name,
  pain_points,
  benefits,
  salary_min,
  salary_max,
  minimum_score,
  status
FROM vacancies 
WHERE status = 'active'
ORDER BY id
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  user_message,
  bot_response,
  extracted_data,
  created_at
FROM n8n_chat_histories
WHERE session_id = $1::uuid
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 15
